title: Fix generated knowledge ownership in post-archive PR audit
outOfScope: Changing production runtime behavior, release workflow behavior, installer behavior, release tags, or public Releases.
Rewriting historical archive evidence or changing the original lock-coverage fix.

sources.reason: The PR audit ownership decision that currently applies restricted-path validation before generated-evidence exemption.
Existing receipt-bound recovery and generated archive ownership regression tests.
Generated source-bound documentation alignment projection required by repository checks.
User-authorized repository issue context for the current cleanup and recovery workflow.
Observed failure: a valid same-Work-Item receipt did not exempt Summary-declared generated knowledge projections from restricted ownership validation.

rawUserRequest: Resolve the post-archive PR audit failure caused by generated knowledge projections being treated as ordinary restricted writes even when a valid same-Work-Item recovery receipt binds the paths.

riskAssessment.reason: The change is limited to PR ownership decision ordering plus a regression test; it does not change runtime, release, installer, or public state.

reasons: Governance checker and regression test only; no production or external operation.

executionDecision.reason: The user-authorized corrective Work Item is bounded to the PR audit ownership decision and its regression test.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A regression test reproduces a Summary-declared generated knowledge path that is also covered by a restricted scope and verifies a valid same-Work-Item receipt permits the path.
The PR audit exempts only validated archive-generated evidence before ordinary ownership/restricted-write evaluation; unrelated restricted paths remain fail-closed.
The focused PR aggregate tests and all required AI/project checks pass, with no runtime, release, installer, tag, or public Release changes.
The archived Outcome is green and the resulting branch is ready to merge before the dependent release Work Item is resumed.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed ownership validation for paths that are not explicitly generated evidence or receipt-bound recovery paths.
Keep the fix minimal and add a regression test for the exact previously failing shape.

intent.problem: After archiving the lock-coverage Work Item, its generated knowledge projections were listed in the frozen Summary and matched the Contract scope. The PR audit therefore entered the restricted-write branch before applying the valid same-Work-Item recovery receipt, incorrectly rejecting the recovery PR.
constraints: Do not weaken restricted ownership policy globally.
Do not rewrite immutable archived Contract/Summary/Outcome evidence.
Only a validated generated-evidence or recovery binding may bypass the ordinary restricted-path error.
intent.rationale: The source of truth is the PR audit decision ordering: generated archive evidence already has a dedicated exact-path validator, so it must be honored before the generic Contract ownership check.

declaredIntent.summary: Make post-archive PR ownership validation honor exact generated-evidence and same-Work-Item recovery bindings before generic restricted-path evaluation.
